name: Building a Rocket
description: A rocket is glued blocks around a Rocket Station.

pages.title: Building a Rocket
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Around a **Rocket Station**: thrusters, fuel tanks, a seat and Rocket Controls.
- Planets also need an Interplanetary Navigator.
- Thruster and fuel needs depend on weight, gravity and distance.
- Sit at the controls and press **jump** to launch.

A rocket is [#](7A3C9A)[glued](entry://glossary/super_glue)[#]() blocks around a Rocket Station. It needs thrusters, fuel in fluid tanks, a seat and Rocket Controls. Trips to planets also need an Interplanetary Navigator.

pages.title: Rocket Station
pages.text: Picks the destination, assembles the rocket and shows fuel, thruster and heat needs. Built around a [#](2E5AAC)[Stellar Core](entry://stars/stellar_core)[#]().

pages.title: Rocket Thruster
pages.text: How many you need depends on the rocket's weight and gravity at both ends. Built from a Combustion Chamber, titanium plates and a Create Propeller.

pages.title: Fuel
pages.text:
Fuel must sit in **fluid tanks** on the rocket. Accepted:

- Liquid Hydrogen, Hydrogen, Methane, Hydrocarbon, Biofuel
- TFMG diesel, gasoline, kerosene and naphtha

Amount depends on gravity at each end and the distance. See [#](2E5AAC)[Oil](entry://industry/tfmg_oil)[#]().

pages.title: Making fuel
pages.text: Hydrocarbon is made by [#](2E5AAC)[heated mixing](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() of Carbon with Sodium or a Sodium Catalyst. Carbon comes from [#](7A3C9A)[compacting](entry://glossary/compacting)[#]() coal with heat, or from a planet's air. Hydrogen and Oxygen come from the Electrolysis Machine. Check [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() for each.

pages.title: Computer Rack
pages.text: Holds Targeting Computers, which find better trajectories and cut fuel cost.

pages.title: Heat shielding
pages.text: Atmosphere friction heats a rocket. Heat shielding goes up by adding metallic blocks anywhere on it. Northstar groups them in tiers: titanium and iron, then Martian steel, then tungsten. The station lists supported blocks.

pages.title: Launching
pages.text:
- Sit at the Rocket Controls and press **jump** to start the launch sequence, jump again to cancel.
- Hold the **slow key** on descent.
- Landings aim at a **Rocket Waypoint**, recorded by using the atlas on it.
- Super Glue holds the rocket together.

pages.title: Rocket Controls
pages.text: Required to launch and steer. Without them the station reports no controls attached.

pages.title: Rocket Waypoint
pages.text: Marks landing coordinates. Use a Space Atlas on it to save the position.

pages.title: Auto-Landing Station
pages.text: Lands the rocket safely on its own.
